Module 1: Corporate Contracts 

  • AoA and MoA - Foundational documents defining a company's purpose and internal regulations.
  • Share Subscription and Share Purchase Agreements - Contracts for acquiring company ownership through share transactions.
  • Shareholders Agreement - Defines rights and obligations of shareholders in a company.
  • Asset Purchase and Business Transfer Agreement - Facilitates the sale of business assets or entire operations.
  • LLP and Partnership Agreement - Establishes terms for limited liability partnerships or traditional partnerships.

Module 2: Real Estate & Government Contracts 

  • Commercial Lease Agreement - Outlines terms for renting commercial property in India.
  • Leave and License Agreement - Common in Maharashtra for short-term property use arrangements.
  • Master Service Agreement - Establishes framework for ongoing services between parties.

Module 3: General Commercial Contracts 

  • Non-Disclosure Agreements - Protects confidential information shared between parties.
  • Power of Attorney - Grants legal authority to act on another's behalf.
  • Staffing Service Agreement - Regulates terms between staffing agencies and client companies.
  • Franchise Agreement - Sets conditions for operating a franchise business in India.

Module 4: Banking Agreements 

  • Individual Loan Agreement - Outlines terms for personal loans from Indian banks.
  • Syndicate Loan Agreement - Governs large loans provided by multiple lenders.
  • Corporate Guarantee - Provides additional security for corporate loans in India.

Module 5: IP Law Contracts 

  • Trademark (Assignment and Licensing) Agreements - Transfers or permits use of trademark rights.
  • Copyright Assignment Agreement - Transfers ownership of copyrighted works in India.
  • Invention Assignment Agreement - Allocates rights to inventions, often in employment contexts.

Module 6: Website Related Contracts 

  • Privacy Policy - Discloses how a website collects and uses user data.
  • Terms of Use - Sets rules for website usage and limits liability.
  • Cookie Policy - Explains use of cookies and similar technologies on websites.

chapter_name: Subject 4: AI & Litigation
chapter_description:
Module 1: Civil Law Fundamentals 

Civil Suits and Petitions

  • Suit for Permanent/Mandatory Injunction - Seeks court order to prohibit or compel specific actions.
  • Commercial Suit - Addresses disputes in commercial transactions under Commercial Courts Act.
  • Summary Suit - Expedited procedure for certain monetary claims in India.

Civil Procedure

  • Written Statement - Defendant's response to plaint, outlining defenses and counter-claims.
  • Application for Rejection of Plaint - Seeks dismissal of suit on procedural grounds.
  • Interlocutory Applications (Order 39 and Order 26 CPC) - Temporary relief during pendency of suit.

Writ Petitions and Supreme Court Appeals

  • Civil Writ Petition before the High Court - Constitutional remedy for violation of fundamental rights.
  • SLP in a civil matter - Special Leave Petition to Supreme Court in civil cases.

Module 2: Criminal Law and Procedure 

Criminal Proceedings

  • Private Complaint before the Magistrate u/s 200 CrPC/173 BNSS - Initiates criminal case by individuals.
  • Application for Anticipatory Bail and Regular Bail Application 
  • Application for Discharge and Application for quashing u/s 518 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023. 

Criminal Appeals and Petitions
